svg.text: FESTIVAL OF TRADITIONAL SPORTS · UNIVERSAL QR LIVE HUB · UI/UX SPECIFICATION
EVENT LIVE HUB · PROGRAMME & QUICK ACCESS
Directly below Live Now. Quick Access stays highly visible and routes to the five main tasks; the timeline
shows the whole day across all venues at a glance.
The next three to four sessions. Each row: start time,
countdown, sport, country, session type, venue badge.
Five large tiles, in the order given in the brief. Every tile
is a one-tap route to a primary task.
Updates: changes and notices, with unread count
A horizontal timeline with one lane per location. Blocks show
sessions; a red line marks the current time and the view opens
A swipeable row of the ten countries with photo, colour and
code. LIVE tag shows which countries are on right now.
Quick Access is the main routing hub of the site.
Mockup content is illustrative. Countries, sports, times and venues are managed in Admin and update live on the public site.
